en.hubeali: H 14547 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Saalim, and others, the following: Abu Abdullahasws having said:

en.sarwar: 99. Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Saalim, and others, the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) having said:
